nodes.name: IndustryMentorRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository providing standard CRUD access to IndustryMentor entities.

nodes.name: PortfolioReviewRequestRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository for PortfolioReviewRequest entities, with queries for mentor pending counts, average response time, and distinct student counts.

nodes.name: CounselorService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining operations for academic counselor dashboards, student management, profile updates, and roster import/export.

nodes.name: EmailService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface for sending feedback notification and password reset emails.

nodes.name: FeedbackService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining CRUD operations for feedback messages (create, modify, mark read, delete).

nodes.name: MentorService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining industry mentor dashboard, directory, review, feedback, and profile operations.

nodes.name: CounselorServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements CounselorService: authenticates the counselor, aggregates career/skill statistics, manages student rosters, feedback, profile updates, and bulk student account import/export.

nodes.name: CounselorServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete implementation of CounselorService orchestrating career statistics, missing-skill analysis, student search, feedback listing, profile CRUD, curriculum listing, and account import/export via multiple repositories and mappers.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedUser
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently authenticated user from the Spring Security context, throwing UnauthorizedException if not found.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedCounselor
nodes.summary: Resolves or lazily creates the AcademicCounselor profile for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: getCareerStatistics
nodes.summary: Aggregates student counts per career role for the counselor dashboard.

nodes.name: getStudentsMissingSkills
nodes.summary: Finds the career matching a search name and computes counts of students missing each required skill for that career.

nodes.name: getAllFeedbacksSentByMe
nodes.summary: Retrieves all feedback sent by the authenticated counselor, ordered by creation date.

nodes.name: getStudentInfos
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated, searchable list of student info projections for the counselor's roster.

nodes.name: getStudentStatisticAndFeedback
nodes.summary: Combines a specific student's roadmap progress, missing skills, and feedback history into one response.

nodes.name: getProfile
nodes.summary: Retrieves the authenticated counselor's profile as an UpdateProfileResponse.

nodes.name: updateProfile
nodes.summary: Updates the authenticated counselor's user and profile fields from an UpdateProfileRequest.

nodes.name: exportStudentList
nodes.summary: Exports a filtered list of students to a downloadable format based on an ExportStudentListRequest.

nodes.name: getCurriculums
nodes.summary: Retrieves available FPT curriculums for use in student account import validation.

nodes.name: checkStudentEmail
nodes.summary: Checks whether a student email is already registered before bulk account import.

nodes.name: importStudentAccounts
nodes.summary: Bulk-creates student accounts from an ImportStudentAccountsRequest, validating emails and encoding passwords.

nodes.name: EmailServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements EmailService, sending password reset and feedback notification emails via a mail sender and EmailUtil-generated OTPs.

nodes.name: EmailServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete implementation of EmailService sending transactional emails for password resets and feedback notifications.

nodes.name: sendPasswordResetEmail
nodes.summary: Composes and sends a password reset email containing a reset link to the given recipient.

nodes.name: sendFeedbackNotificationEmail
nodes.summary: Composes and sends an email notifying a user that they received new feedback.

nodes.name: FeedbackServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements FeedbackService: creates, modifies, marks read, and deletes feedback messages, validating attachments and authorization.

nodes.name: FeedbackServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete implementation of FeedbackService handling feedback creation with attachments, edits, read-marking, deletion, and response mapping.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedUser
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently authenticated user for feedback operations, throwing UnauthorizedException if absent.

nodes.name: createFeedback
nodes.summary: Creates a new feedback message with optional file attachments, validating file constraints and persisting the entity.

nodes.name: modifyFeedback
nodes.summary: Updates the content and attachments of an existing feedback message, enforcing sender authorization.

nodes.name: markReadFeedback
nodes.summary: Marks a feedback message as read by the authenticated receiver.

nodes.name: deleteFeedback
nodes.summary: Deletes a feedback message after verifying the requester is the original sender.

nodes.name: toCrudFeedbackResponse
nodes.summary: Converts a Feedback entity into a response DTO for create/update/delete operation results.

nodes.name: MentorServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements MentorService: dashboard metrics, mentor directory, pending portfolio reviews, career distribution, profile management, feedback history, progress reports, and feedback submission for industry mentors.

nodes.name: MentorServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete implementation of MentorService orchestrating mentor dashboards, directories, reviews, feedback, and profile updates via multiple repositories.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedMentor
nodes.summary: Resolves the authenticated user's IndustryMentor profile, enforcing authentication.

nodes.name: getDashboardMetrics
nodes.summary: Aggregates key mentor dashboard metrics such as pending reviews, average response time, and distinct student counts.

nodes.name: getWelcomeAlert
nodes.summary: Builds a welcome alert summarizing pending review counts for the mentor dashboard.

nodes.name: getInsight
nodes.summary: Computes a summary insight statistic for the mentor dashboard.

nodes.name: formatResponseTime
nodes.summary: Formats a raw response-time value in seconds into a human-readable string.

nodes.name: getInitials
nodes.summary: Extracts initials from a full name string, used for avatar placeholders in mentor/student listings.

nodes.name: getRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Converts a timestamp into a human-readable relative time string (e.g., '2 days ago').

nodes.name: getPendingReviews
nodes.summary: Retrieves the list of pending portfolio review requests assigned to the authenticated mentor.

nodes.name: getStudentInfos
nodes.summary: Returns a list of student info summaries associated with the mentor.

nodes.name: getMentorDirectory
nodes.summary: Retrieves a directory listing of available industry mentors.

nodes.name: getCareerDistribution
nodes.summary: Computes the distribution of mentored students across career paths.

nodes.name: getMentorProfile
nodes.summary: Retrieves the authenticated mentor's profile details.

nodes.name: updateMentorProfile
nodes.summary: Updates the authenticated mentor's profile fields from an UpdateMentorProfileRequest.

nodes.name: getFeedbackHistory
nodes.summary: Retrieves the mentor's history of feedback given to students.

nodes.name: getProgressReports
nodes.summary: Builds detailed progress reports for students under mentorship, combining roadmap and skill data.

nodes.name: submitFeedback
nodes.summary: Submits mentor feedback for a student, creating a Feedback entity and updating related review status.

nodes.name: EmailUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility class providing OTP generation used for email-based verification flows.

nodes.name: generateOtp
nodes.summary: Generates a random numeric one-time password used in email verification and reset flows.
